outputs.explanation: Panel A shows an H&E image and spatial gene expression heatmap overlays on tissue, not a quantitative summary plot.
Panel B consists of H&E and RNAscope fluorescence micrographs, not a quantitative plot.
Panel C is a scatter plot displaying individual patient tumor data points (each dot = one sample) with median and 95% CI overlaid, so individual values are shown.
Panel D is a bar chart (mean ± SD) with individual data points (dots) overlaid for each group (n=3), satisfying the requirement.
